Working notes (updated REQ-2400–2409)

Rule inferred: Option C (regional office) is accepted only for claim requests from the north or south region.
- Accepted C: claims from north/south, both small and large.
- Rejected C: all invoice requests; all refund requests; claim from east region.

Size does not decide acceptance: small/large claims can be accepted; all invoices rejected regardless of size.
Region matters for claims: north/south accepted, east rejected.
Request type matters: claim can pass; invoice/refund fail with C.

For future assignment:
- If request = claim AND region is north or south: choose C.
- If request = invoice OR refund OR claim from east: do NOT choose C; it will be rejected. Correct alternative not yet identified—use A/B fallback only if policy allows, but no positive evidence yet.
- Do not rely on sender, department, subject wording, or urgency phrases like “client asking twice,” “second attempt,” or “scanned, not typed.” No consistent effect observed.

Evidence summary:
C accepted: REQ-2402, 2405, 2406, 2409.
C rejected: REQ-2400, 2401, 2403, 2404, 2407, 2408.

Open question: which option is correct for non-C cases. Need more data on A vs B.

Working notes (updated through REQ-2419)

C: still only positive for claim requests from north/south. REQ-2410 confirms south claim + C accepted. C remains rejected for invoices/refunds and east claim; no new C data.

A: now has positive cases, so old “alternative unknown” is outdated. A accepted for:
- refund, north, large (2413)
- shipment, east, large (2415)
- invoice, north, small (2417)
A rejected for:
- invoice, large, south/north/east (2411, 2412, 2414, 2416)
- shipment, large, south/north (2418, 2419)

Old rule “size does not decide acceptance” is too broad. Size matters at least for invoices: small north invoice accepts A; all tested large invoices reject A. Region and type also interact.

Tentative decision:
- claim + north/south -> C.
- invoice + small + north -> A (weak, one case).
- refund + north -> A (weak, one case).
- shipment + east -> A (weak, one case).
- Other non-C cases: avoid A where rejected; likely B, but no positive B evidence yet. Need tests for large invoices, shipments north/south, east claims, refunds south/east, and small invoices outside north.

Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency phrases (“second attempt”, “client asking twice”, “same as last month”, “scanned/not typed”). No consistent effect observed.

Open questions:
- Is B correct for all large invoices?
- Do shipments north/south go to B or C?
- What handles east claims and non-north refunds?
- Does small size change the invoice rule outside north?

Working notes (updated through REQ-2429)

C: still only positive for claim requests north/south. No new C data. C invalid for invoices/refunds and east claim (prior).

A:
- refund + north -> A: large (2413, 2420), small (2427). Strong.
- shipment + east + large -> A (2415, 2429). Strong for large; small untested.
- invoice + small + north -> A (2417 only).
Rejected A: invoice large south/north/east; shipment large south/north. Avoid A there.

B:
- invoice + large + north -> B accepted (2421). New positive; A rejected there.
- B rejected for: refund south small (2422), shipment south small (2423), refund east large (2424), invoice east large (2425), shipment north small (2426), shipment south large (2428).
So B is not a general fallback; only known valid for invoice large north.

Old “size does not decide” corrected: size/type/region interact. Large invoice north goes B; small invoice north goes A. Large refund north still A.

Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency/scanned phrases; no consistent effect.

Tentative rules:
- claim + north/south -> C.
- refund + north -> A.
- shipment + east + large -> A.
- invoice + small + north -> A (weak, one case).
- invoice + large + north -> B.
- Else unknown; do not use B unless above.

Open questions:
- Refund south/east: B invalid; A/C?
- Shipment south (small/large): B invalid; A rejected large; C?
- Shipment north small: B invalid; A/C?
- Invoice east large: A/B rejected; what valid?
- Small invoice outside north; shipment east small.

Working notes (updated through REQ-2439)

C: valid for claim + north/south (including large: 2430, 2439). Invalid for invoices/refunds and east claim.

A:
- refund + north -> A (large/small: 2413, 2420, 2427, 2431).
- refund + small + south -> A (2435, 2437).
- refund + small + east -> A (2432).
- shipment + east + large -> A (2415, 2429).
- invoice + small + north -> A (2417 only).
Rejected A: invoice large south/north/east; invoice east small (2433); shipment large south/north; shipment south small (2436).

B:
- invoice + large + north -> B (2421).
- B rejected for refund south small, shipment south small, refund east large, invoice east large, shipment north small, shipment south large.
Only known valid B: invoice large north. Not a general fallback.

D:
- invoice + south + small -> D (2434).
- shipment + south + large -> D (2438).
No other D evidence.

Size/type/region interact. Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency, scanned phrases.

Tentative rules:
- claim + north/south -> C.
- refund + north -> A; refund + small + south/east -> A.
- shipment + east + large -> A.
- shipment + south + large -> D.
- invoice + small + north -> A (weak); invoice + small + south -> D.
- invoice + large + north -> B.
- Else unknown; do not use B unless invoice large north.

Open:
- Refund south/east large.
- Shipment south small; shipment north small; shipment east small.
- Invoice east small/large; invoice south large; small invoice outside north/south.
- D validity outside invoice south small and shipment south large.

Working notes (updated through REQ-2449)

C: valid for claim + north/south, including small/large (2430, 2439, 2445). Invalid for invoices/refunds and east claim.

A:
- refund + north -> A (2413, 2420, 2427, 2431).
- refund + small + south -> A (2435, 2437, 2447).
- refund + small + east -> A (2432).
- shipment + east + large -> A (2415, 2429, 2449). Not shipment east small (2448 rejected A).
- invoice + small + north -> A (2417, 2441).
Rejected A: claim east small (2444); invoice large south/north/east; invoice east small (2433); shipment large south/north; shipment south small (2436); shipment east small (2448).

B:
- invoice + large + north -> B (2421, 2440, 2442).
Rejected B: refund south small; shipment south small; refund east large; invoice east large; shipment north small; shipment south large; shipment north large (2443).
Only known valid B: invoice large north. Not a general fallback.

D:
- invoice + south + small -> D (2434).
- shipment + south + large -> D (2438).
- shipment + south + small -> D (2446).
No other D evidence.

Size/type/region interact. Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency, scanned phrases.

Tentative rules:
- claim + north/south -> C.
- refund + north -> A; refund + small + south/east -> A.
- shipment + east + large -> A.
- shipment + south + large/small -> D.
- invoice + small + north -> A; invoice + small + south -> D.
- invoice + large + north -> B.
- Else unknown; do not use B unless invoice large north.

Open:
- Claim east small/large; claim other regions.
- Refund south/east large.
- Shipment north small/large; shipment east small.
- Invoice east small/large; invoice south large; small invoice outside north/south.
- D validity outside south shipments and invoice south small.

Working notes updated through REQ-2459

C:
- claim + north/south, small/large -> C (2430,2439,2445,2453,2455).
- Invalid for invoices/refunds; east claim not supported.

A:
- refund + north -> A (2413,2420,2427,2431).
- refund + south, small/large -> A (2435,2437,2447,2454).
- refund + small + east -> A (2432).
- shipment + east + large -> A (2415,2429,2449). Not shipment east small (2448 rejected A; 2450 rejected D).
- invoice + small + north -> A (2417,2441,2452,2456).
Rejected A: claim east small (2444); invoice large south/north/east; invoice east small (2433); shipment large south/north; shipment south small (2436); shipment east small (2448).

B:
- invoice + large + north -> B (2421,2440,2442).
Only known valid B; not a fallback.

D:
- invoice + small + south -> D (2434).
- invoice + small + east -> D (2457,2459).
- shipment + south + large -> D (2438).
- shipment + south + small -> D (2446,2451).
Rejected D: shipment east small (2450); claim east small (2458).

Rules:
- claim + north/south -> C (any size).
- refund + north -> A; refund + south small/large -> A; refund + small + east -> A.
- shipment + east + large -> A; shipment + south small/large -> D.
- invoice + small + north -> A; invoice + small + south/east -> D; invoice + large + north -> B.
- Else unknown. Do not use B unless invoice large north. Do not use D for shipment east small or claim east small.
- Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency, scanned phrases.

Open:
- Claim east and other regions.
- Refund east large; refund outside north/south/east-small.
- Shipment north any; shipment east small.
- Invoice east large; invoice south large; small invoice outside north/south/east.
- D validity outside known cases.

Working notes updated through REQ-2469.

C:
- claim + north/south, small/large -> C (2430,2439,2445,2453,2455).
- shipment + north + large -> C (2467).
- Invalid for invoices/refunds; claim east not supported.

A:
- refund + north -> A (2413,2420,2427,2431,2462).
- refund + south, small/large -> A (2435,2437,2447,2454).
- refund + small + east -> A (2432).
- shipment + east + large -> A (2415,2429,2449,2460,2464,2468). Not shipment east small.
- invoice + small + north -> A (2417,2441,2452,2456).
Rejected A: claim east small (2444); invoice large south/north/east; invoice east small (2433); shipment large south/north; shipment south small (2436); shipment east small (2448); shipment north small (2463,2466).

B:
- invoice + large + north -> B (2421,2440,2442).
Only known valid B; not a fallback.

D:
- invoice + small + south -> D (2434).
- invoice + small + east -> D (2457,2459).
- invoice + large + east -> D (2461,2465).
- shipment + south + large -> D (2438,2469).
- shipment + south + small -> D (2446,2451).
Rejected D: shipment east small (2450); claim east small (2458).

Rules:
- claim + north/south -> C (any size).
- shipment + north large -> C; shipment + north small -> not A (unknown).
- refund + north -> A; refund + south small/large -> A; refund + small + east -> A.
- shipment + east + large -> A; shipment + south small/large -> D.
- invoice + small + north -> A; invoice + small + south/east -> D; invoice + large + north -> B; invoice + large + east -> D.
- Else unknown. Do not use B unless invoice large north. Do not use A for shipment north small. Do not use D for shipment east small or claim east small.
- Ignore sender, department, subject wording, urgency, scanned phrases.

Open:
- Claim east and other regions.
- Refund east large; refund outside north/south/east-small.
- Shipment north small; shipment east small.
- Invoice south large; small invoice outside north/south/east.
- D validity outside known cases.
